senses.gloss:
लोध लोध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous, per-
plexed, confused (= लुब्ध according to the Nirukta
and Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 53, 23, according to
others it may mean ‘red’ or may be the name of a
particular animal); (अस्), m. = लोध्र below.

लोध्र लोध्र, अस्, m. = रोध्र, a tree the
bark of which is used in dyeing, Symplocos Race-
mosa.
